title: Wah Tin
safeHtml:
'''Wah Tin''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is the Northernmost Sub-District of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-01.

History

The name of this Sub-District originates from the deceased Grandfather of the Developer of Asylum who passed away a few years ago. Since then, the Developer has always wanted to use this name at cities that he constructed, and eventually this name is used to the northeast of Arctic Sea to symbolize prosperity.

Prior to the relocation of the Asylum City Center from Arctic Sea to Brighton Hall, Wah Tin was planned to contain Public Housing Settlements within a close vicinity to the Town Center. However, Public Housing in Wah Tin is now considered rural.

During development, Barode Cave, a natural landscape within the vicinity, had been briefly removed, but was ultimately restored due to excessive backlash. Currently, there are plans to transform the cave into a park that is situated near Barode Cave Station and a Bus Terminus.

The Developer originally anticipated to turn east to the north of Arctic Sea, and reach Coopol after going deep into this district, while would run parallel to Route 3 to the east of Wah Tin before proceeding to Coopol Station. However, after Nazca Railway released plans for the Ingress Continent in the 2024 Development Plans, this plan was scrapped, and the decision was made to expand the size of public housing in Wah Tin. As a result, over 60% of this Sub-District is Public House, and this also reflects the fact that real-life Public Housing Projects such as Fu Shin Estate, Fu Heng Estate and Wah Ming Estate tend to be situated far away from Railway Stations.

In the Original Plans, Public Housing in Wah Tin are few and far between, namely Kam Wing Estate, Kam Cheong Estate and Kam Tai Estate. However, due to scenic and environmental concerns, Density of the Public Housing have increased, which resulted in estates such as Kam Heng Estate and Kam Yiu Estate.

In order to Commemorate the Relative of the Developer of Asylum, all Public Housing in Wah Tin starts with the word "Kam", and all Home Ownership Scheme Housing ends with the word "Wah".

Future Development

There has been collaborations between the Developers of Asylum and Coopol regarding the development of the Lucky Pit Area, and more public housing may possibly be built to the north of Tai Hong Street. If the plans comes to fruition, "Kam Shing Estate", "Kam Yan Estate", "Kam Hong Estate" and "Kam Chung Estate" will be built.

Description

was the eleventh District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled along the south coast of Vertin Peninsula in an east-west orientation.
